goal: Real-time crypto futures training bot with high OOS return, controlled MDD, sufficient trade volume, and realistic execution costs.

current_model_oos.note: Omega4.6 is current research/upgrade baseline only. Max-hold and PnL target are excluded from mandatory pass; day-trading live promotion remains blocked until a successor solves hold-time without killing alpha.

active_feature_contracts.futures_risk_sizing_contract: Omega risk heads/sidecars must distinguish price-move targets, margin_fraction, leverage, and notional explicitly. Required sizing contract: notional = margin_fraction * leverage; PnL = price_move * notional.
active_feature_contracts.futures_risk_spec_removed_fields: Do not multiply leverage again after notional is derived. If leverage is fixed, document the fixed value and derive notional from margin_fraction.
active_feature_contracts.futures_risk_blocker: New active/live Omega risk artifacts that directly learn account-threshold heads such as long_take_profit/long_stop_loss are blockers unless the run is explicitly historical reproduction.
active_feature_contracts.omega_required_parent_prediction_files: train_predictions_qXXX.csv, validation_predictions_qXXX.csv, oos_predictions_qXXX.csv where qXXX = round(quality_threshold * 100) zero-padded.
active_feature_contracts.regime4_current_note: DSAC/Router active specs must drop ambiguous legacy prefixes and use the explicit state24 sticky090 v2 prefix. clean_regime4_2024_unsup_v1_* and clean_regime_2024_unsup_v4_* are allowed only for historical reproduction/debug.
active_feature_contracts.legacy_regime_doc_policy: Docs Manager must document clean_regime_2024_unsup_v4_* and clean_regime4_2024_unsup_v1_* as historical/reference-only, not active inputs, even when old audit rows contain legacy regime verdicts.
active_feature_contracts.funding_clean_gate: Any active/live or promotion candidate using funding-family columns or artifacts that may embed them must prove ETHUSDT-only backward/as-of clean funding provenance. Direct CSV patching is not enough for old derived artifacts.
active_feature_contracts.regime3_redesign_note: For new action-classifier/Alpha8+ candidates, bull/bear/chop are the medium-horizon structure classes. Whipsaw is risk/veto/sizing context, not an independent action-regime class.
active_feature_contracts.regime3_pred_direction_removed: regime3_pred_* future-class probabilities are removed from active action/direction ownership. They must not drive long/short direction, primary/fallback labels, or hard future regime selection.
active_feature_contracts.regime3_risk_features_only: Use regime3_stability_h6_score, regime3_transition_h6_risk_prob, regime3_transition_h6_risk_pred, and regime3_churn_h6_risk_score only as stability/transition-risk context for veto, size throttle, leverage reduction, and TP/SL/hold tightening.

current_candidate_architecture.router_context: a5dir_* from Router5 CatBoost auxiliary probabilities
current_candidate_architecture.forbidden_action_owner: CatBoost Major/Direction or Router layer direct LONG/SHORT/CASH ownership

agents.name: Model Architect
agents.mission: Design supervised, unsupervised, deep learning, RL model architecture, and the required data/state contracts for the trading bot.

agents.name: Data Architect
agents.mission: Legacy alias. Data pipeline, market state contract, signal/noise filtering, and live data quality controls are now owned by Model Architect.

agents.name: Red Team
agents.mission: Adversarially test model logic, data bias, execution costs, slippage, leverage, and live safety assumptions.

agents.name: Implementation Maintainer
agents.mission: Implement architect and red-team recommendations as maintainable code, refactor safely, and run targeted verification.

agents.name: Docs Manager
agents.mission: Maintain the docs folder, especially active/live specifications, so model and trading bot code changes update architecture, runtime, and module contracts in the same change set.

promotion_gate.default_on_failure: keep conservative baseline or rollback from controller to compact

rule_contract.behavior: entry-time exposure gate; if condition hits, notional and leverage are scaled by hit_scale
